findings.reason: the key must be the exemption's derived answer (role-exempt or review-id-prefix) rather than the raw role and node id, or the unit's stated effect on the uncovered path is not delivered and the measured 1,250–2,980 s remains on exactly the requests that go through the fallback.
findings.text: s4 keys the dispatch-gate memo by "the section the request builds, its role, and its node id", but a node is queued at most once per (project, plan, section, node id) while queued, being admitted or in flight (`reckon/crew/runs.py:555-585`, reached from `reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2134` before a second request is written), so no two requests in one pass share all three; `routing._plan_review_exempt` (`reckon/crew/routing.py:2454-2470`) decides only on the two derived booleans "role in `PLAN_BUILD_EXEMPT_ROLES`" and "id starts with `review-of-` or `plan-review-of-` (`reckon/crew/recovery_vocabulary.py:146-147`)" — so the raw node id adds no correctness and removes all sharing, leaving `_dispatch_gate_owed` → `require_plan_reviewed` to re-run `resolve_dispatch_authority`, `store_delivered_reviews`, `newest_design_review`, `review_coverage`, `read_plan_review` and `list_plan_reviews` for every request on an uncovered plan

findings.reason: the case and its control must name a population where two requests share a memo key (two implement requests on the same uncovered section, with a review-role request beside them to show the exempt answer is not reused), otherwise the arm measures nothing and a no-op memo ships green.
findings.text: s4's second case counts `require_plan_reviewed` calls "once per section, role and node those requests carry, not once per request", and its negative control is "reading the dispatch-gate fallback per request fails the second": because the queue admits one request per (plan, section, node id), "per section, role and node" equals "per request" in every fixture the queue can produce, so the base revision (which calls the gate per request) passes the case and the stated control cannot fail
